description: MAJOR EVENT PHOTOGRAPH — AERIAL OF A BURNING AIRBASE. From altitude, a towering column of dense black smoke rises thousands of feet from a point on an airfield complex, with ORANGE FLAME clearly visible at its base. Below: a long runway/taxiway system runs diagonally at left, surrounded by cantonment areas — rows of buildings, revetments, cleared red-earth construction ground — with roads, villages, and green paddies stretching away to a hazy horizon. A second, thinner smoke drift trails at upper left. Shot through an aircraft window/door in flight.
